== Summary ==
Identified: [[Angelo Consoli]] (plaid shirt with pinned cards, glasses, khaki pants, light-blue hoodie over his shoulders; same face as [[:File:Angelo Consoli 2013 Hall of Fame.jpg]] and the Obi-Wan Kenobi shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]).
